ingestion_contract.adapter_required: true — maps must pass through adapter_binding before image_app consumption.
ingestion_contract.contract_fields: source_video_id, layout_map, depth_map, pose_map, blocking_map, environment_reference_bank_ref, object_reference_bank_ref, temporal_memory_ref.
ingestion_contract.validation_mode: ingestion_only — metadata binding without GPU raster generation or backend execution.
ingestion_contract.not_production_replica_flag: Set when fallback_text_path is used instead of backend map ingestion.

map_binding_format.source_video_id: Canonical numerical DNA source identifier from conditioning map export.
map_binding_format.map_type: Map enum: layout_map | depth_map | pose_map | blocking_map.
map_binding_format.frame_selector: Frame index or timestamp_ms selector for per-shot ingestion.
map_binding_format.binding_target: Image app conditioning slot: controlnet_layout | controlnet_depth | openpose | regional_blocking.

reference_bank_binding.binding_id: Unique reference bank binding record identifier.
reference_bank_binding.anchor_images_ref: Metadata path to anchor_images array in bank entry.
reference_bank_binding.identity_level: Object identity lock enum when bank_type=object_reference_bank.

temporal_binding.edit_rhythm_signature: Edit rhythm hash bound to shot duration and cut_type.
temporal_binding.continuity_signature: Shot boundary continuity hash for adjacent shot lookup.
temporal_binding.causal_transition_chain: Ordered transition_id list for scene transition traversal.

adapter_binding.supported_maps: Maps translatable by selected adapter per ADAPTER_TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_REPORT.
adapter_binding.recommended_adapter: comfyui_adapter — lowest translation_loss per adapter translation validation.

fallback_text_path.trigger: backend map ingestion unavailable or adapter_binding fails validation.
fallback_text_path.preserved_constraints: Narrative text constraints, blocking labels, and scene_remap gonegi_scene_id when maps unavailable.
fallback_text_path.degraded_fields: layout_map, depth_map, pose_map raster control signals; environment/object IP-Adapter weights.
fallback_text_path.fallback_behavior: If backend map ingestion is unavailable, degrade to text spatial compiler with NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA flag.

runtime_bridge.description: Metadata bridge binding conditioning map export, reference banks, temporal memory, and adapter translation into image_app ingestion contract without GPU execution.

binding_rules: Bind layout_map, depth_map, pose_map, and blocking_map from conditioning-map-export-bundle by source_video_id + frame_selector.
Resolve environment_reference_bank entries by environment_id via ENVIRONMENT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION.
Resolve object_reference_bank entries by object_id with identity_level and variation_tolerance from OBJECT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION.
Attach temporal_memory records by timeline_id from TEMPORAL_MEMORY_SPECIFICATION for edit rhythm and causal transitions.
Route translatable maps through comfyui_adapter per adapter_binding before image_app runtime_bridge consumption.
When any required map binding fails, activate fallback_text_path with NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA flag.
translation_path: runtime_bridge → image_app conditioning slots OR fallback_text_path → ConditionedPromptBuilder
fallback_behavior: If backend map ingestion is unavailable, degrade to text spatial compiler with NOT_PRODUCTION_REPLICA flag.
